title: Camp Cabin Common Room?
content: I have recently been reading this thread a lot after stumbling upon it. It reminds me of a dream I had before finding this sub it was months ago though. Does anyone recall a sort of common area it reminded me of a camp cabin or dining hall possibly. I recall people coming and going and a girl had basically explained to me that we were all in a dream state and that this was one of the spaces where we could interact with one another. I remember her alluding to some sort of online community. Idk super vague like I said it was a while ago but has anyone had a similar experience?
